mobile_projects_folders: Collapsed section at the end of the phone's home: folders opened in Atlas Desktop that are not projects (no atlas.yaml, not a git checkout)
mobile_projects_folders_hint: Explanation under the Other folders section header on the phone's home
mobile_projects_search_clear: Accessibility label of the button that empties the project search
mobile_projects_search_empty: Shown instead of the project list when the search finds nothing; query is what the user typed
mobile_projects_search_hint: Placeholder of the search field above the project list on the phone's home
mobile_projects_stack_stop: Button in a running project's status panel on the phone that stops its whole stack (every service)
mobile_projects_stack_stopping: The Stop button of a project while its stack is stopping
mobile_projects_worktrees_hide: Row under a project on the phone's home that folds its expanded worktrees back
mobile_projects_worktrees_show: Row under a project on the phone's home that unfolds its idle worktrees; count is how many. i18n-allow pt-zero: only shown when the project has at least one idle worktree (the fold row in features/home/dashboard.dart)
